I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm or contradict the 8 April renewal date because I found no record of Brackenwater Freight Co. she can see. It isn't mentioned in #central-team, and no shared file covers it: no contract, CRM or profile.

I told her to treat the date as unconfirmed until the account owner or deal desk checks it against the signed contract, or the customer confirms it in writing. I didn't record the date anywhere else or say it was confirmed.
